design.decision_question: Should the Laravel 12 test/CI lane use Pest ^4.7 while Laravel 13 retains Pest ^5.2?
design.evidence_gap: Accepted D37 specifies Pest ^5.2 across L12/L13, but the upstream Process constraints have no intersection. The proposed L12 exception passes the unchanged 818 tests.
alternatives: Pest ^4.7 for L12 only; Pest ^5.2 for L13
Retain the accepted policy and wait for a compatible Pest 5 release
design.expected_artifact: Qualified D37 amendment and matching P01.1/P01.4 runbook instructions
